notes.title: Chaos Chain Dev Update 9/3/21
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

I'm back with another quick status update. I wanted to go over another QOL feature I created today.

In the past with my games, I have always had some non-important NPCs with generic greetings. These could be common people, guards, and even some enemies. Their messages could contain useful information or lore, but they were mainly just there to populate the game world and simulate an inhabited location such as a village or hideout.

The issue I had with the system was that their dialogue was not important, but still appeared as a regular message and even if they only had a few words to say, it would take a good moment to read and then you'd have to click again on them to make the message go away. Not a huge deal, but since it's not anything important, it could be annoying and feel repetitive.

So, I created a system that I call "SpeakUp". It's very simple and it's just an addition to a system I already had in place, but it makes the game flow better in my opinion.

[i]Speak Up[/i]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/973622e22d781d2b5a98256218c304fe5dc67f5f.png[/img]

In the above screenshot, I am just talking to a generic NPC Junkie who apparently doesn't like the look of my character. He doesn't have any vital information, but some of his randomized lines may prove to have lore, information, or hints about the game world just like in my previous projects.

Some of you will find this familiar if you've played my last game, Lawless Lands. In that game, whenever you got a reputation change, experience, traveled, or when the weather changed, a message would appear similarly to let you know what happened.

Now, when you're talking to an NPC who isn't plot-related, their message will appear on the screen for a moment and they'll show a chat bubble over their head to let you know they're speaking to you. A faint sound will also play.

Anyways, that's all for now. I hope to get more done next week - I have been sick this week so didn't have much energy to tackle anything too big.

I'll have more info soon!

Thank you for reading!

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Chaos Chain Dev Update: 9/2/21
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

I apologize for not posting earlier this week, I know some of you have been eagerly waiting to see more about the new upcoming game Chaos Chain, but I have been very sick and in bed most of the time until now. I am finally starting to feel better.

Anyways, today I only have one screenshot to show off a new QOL feature because I have only worked a half day today. Hoping to get more done tomorrow.

[i]Floating Labels[/i]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/fc5e674118fb5e4c1186ce97f7c49c69f0a157b8.png[/img]

This might seem like a minor feature, but in the past with my games, people have mentioned they don't always know or understand what they can interact with. I have always made it so that if you hover the mouse over something that can be used, hover text (labels) appear over top of it. Now, you will have the option to simply toggle them always on. It may get a bit cluttered on the screen in small areas from time to time, but I have the opacity lowered a bit from my other projects to allow better visibility and high-contrast text to be able to properly see the label itself.

I have added an option to the settings menu that allows you to permanently enable or disable floating labels - independently of the mouse. If you disable the feature, you will get labels when you hover over something with the mouse, but they will always be on if the setting is enabled. Some people tend to disable the mouse, but this change will still allow this feature to work.

Something else that is kind of visible in the screenshot is the red diamond over the door. This is just an indicator that I created (it pulses over time) to signify that an otherwise static environmental object (such as a door, trash can, etc) can be interacted with. Doors that can be opened to travel to another area have blue arrows inside of them as well.

That's all for now, thank you for reading. Hopefully, I can have more info and screenshots soon. 

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Chaos Chain - Equipment Briefing
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

[u]For those of you who missed the last announcement discussing my next project[/u], [i]Chaos Chain[/i], you can find that here to get you up to date: 

https://steamcommunity.com/groups/CorrosiveStudios/announcements/detail/5246117291297561777

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/37cf25db4ec95381cb2716184fc089383d55739f.jpg[/img]

[b]For those of you who already know of the new game, let's talk about equipment.[/b]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/64df151097805d3f020cf38222ae5ff5ab46baa3.png[/img]

[h1]Equipment[/h1] has always played a significant role in my past games. Having the right tools for the job at hand is extremely important in my opinion, so I try to put that into the game worlds.

For [i]Chaos Chain[/i], this will still apply, but the system has been expanded and improved from my other projects.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/e79ae69e93dd2b97e560bd4ca9c4d5fd258f6772.png[/img]

First, as you can hopefully see in the image above, weapons have a pretty significant stat-line. A lot is taken into account and much thought went into how the stats function and what ratings each weapon was given. It may look simplistic, but each specific stat has a lot of factors to think about such as handling, ease of use, accuracy, speed, range, capabilities of fire modes such as semi, burst, and auto. The engine is somewhat limited, but I have done my best so far (still a lot of room for improvement) to make weapons feel unique.

Second, I've done A LOT of work on improving the combat system. I can't really show it off here right now, but something I'd like to mention is an EXTREME focus on sound effects and quick-flow combat. Weapons have unique sound effects and animations so you can tell what you are using compared to your enemies. I have improved the default battle sound system to include a variety of sound effects for each event so it's not always the same exact boring sound. There are several sound effects for each event like for example an evasion/dodge has multiple sounds of its own and then there are special sounds for bullets missing or a melee weapon hitting someone. I personally think that sounds make or break a game - especially when you're hearing the same ones over... and over... and over.

So far, I have around 50 or so weapons which are mostly melee weapons and improvised weapons, but I have a handful of fictional (based on real) firearms across a variety of different archtypes including pistols, PDWs (personal defense weapons), SMGs (submachine guns), shotguns, assault rifles, battle rifles, carbines, sniper rifles, machine guns, rocket launchers, grenade launchers, special weapons, and even some exotic weaponry. Not all of these are ready yet, but that's the weapon archtype/class lineup I'm going for. Like in my first game, [i]Waste Walkers[/i], firearms will allow for different ammunition types such as full metal jacket, hollow point, armor piercing, buckshot, slugshot, and birdshot, and even more are planned to be added. Depending on your preference, the different ammunitions will provide different bonuses.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/dc388ee7d346efb58f2c76172103a2de5ecb95a9.png[/img]

Armor is the same way - they have a lot to take into account. One flaw of my previous games in my opinion is that armor resistances were very minor. A 5% here, maybe a lucky 15% there, etc. The idea was to stack up on resistances you favored with your combination of chosen gear. Most of the time, the numbers didn't add up enough to actually make any significant impact. That will NOT be the case here. The equipment slot system is more straight forward, but each slot has a specific purpose. Armor is armor. It should feel like it. In the above picture, you can see the current (subject to change) stats for the ballistic vest. The resistance percentages are high enough by themselves to actually protect you from different damage types, but they may be bolstered even more by accompanying gear in other slots such as the head slot for headgear or even the accessory slot.

Theoretically speaking, if your punk has 8 health remaining and an enemy thug stabs you with a shiv for 10 puncture damage (lucky roll) and you have a protection (armor) value of 2, a toughness of 4, and a 25% puncture resistance, you'll only take 3 damage. The detailed math: 10 damage - (2 protection - 4 toughness) * .75 = 3. That's pretty helpful. Taking a third of the dealt damage because of having decent armor instead of the full amount just kept you alive. A leather jacket (armor 1 with a puncture protection of 5%) would have left you dead in the street. The differences between armor types should no longer feel minimal.

That's all for now, I'll have more information soon!

Thanks for reading!

-[b]Eric "Corrosion" Plasencia

notes.title: What's Next from Corrosive Studios? "Chaos Chain"
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone, Corrosion here.[/b]

So, several people have been asking me recently about what I've been working on lately.

I didn't want to give any info out too early, but I think now is a great time for me to tell you all a bit about my new project. 

Let me start by saying that it's very early in development, so nothing you see is finalized.

[h2]Chaos Chain[/h2]
[i]A dark cyberpunk roleplaying game by Corrosive Studios[/i]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/37cf25db4ec95381cb2716184fc089383d55739f.jpg[/img]

-This is a project that I have been working on for a few months and it's finally starting to actually take form. The game is heavily inspired by a variety of movies and games including The Matrix, Johnny Mnemonic, Shadowrun, The Terminator, Total Recall, Repo Men, Cyberpunk 2021 (RPG), and a whole lot more. Of course, I'm only trying to get inspiration for the genre, so Chaos Chain will have a lot of its own content and lore. I'm really passionate about bringing this all to life, so I hope some of you like it so far.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/ad37bef03793018501f2f1a2c1573b88391c1e1a.gif[/img]

[h2]Background:[/h2]
[i]"Half a century into the future, mankind's world is riven and in a state of great social, political, and economic strain... After the end of the horrific pandemic that haunted the early twenties, big pharma became stronger than ever seen before. Medical research thrived and allowed for a multitude of tech advancements, but healthcare prices skyrocketed, causing mass inflation and shifting the world's economy... As a result, cryptocurrencies grew in popularity and eventually gained enough momentum to replace other monetary systems across the globe... Greed, hatred, envy, and panic then fueled the fires of war time after time, leaving the world scarred and broken. The U.N. has fallen and the war on terror has failed. Civilization is slowly collapsing in on itself... Now, most people cannot afford their basic needs. Society is fragmented and has dissolved back into a rigid caste division. Crime is at an all-time high and poverty is the new norm. Each day that passes, exploitation of the Earth's resources continues and pollution intensifies, making life even more unbearable... Humanity is in the darkest place of its entire existence... A dark place where you exist."[/i]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/fecced5e2930fa5078cdd9757356c4f6e914ceb0.jpg[/img]

[u]It's still very early off, and it will be a bit before anything is playable, but it's getting there.[/u]

-For the game's mechanics, I have read through a lot of reviews and feedback that I've gained over the years. I tried to create a good mix of both complexity and simplicity to make the game straight forward, but also unique, also while being enjoyable. There is no durability, no overly complicated armor systems, damage is straight forward, weapons and classifications for them are easy to understand, and so on.

-I want to create a game with a HEAVY EMPHASIS ON ACTUAL ROLEPLAYING. In the past, I did this with Lawless Lands, but I want it to have even more depth. Branching dialogues, non-linear sequences, player-influenced-events based on choices and character builds, and many other ideas. I want the player's place in the game to have a direct tie in to what they do. For better or for worse. I also want to highlight that the game will not be combat focused. It will still feature combat though. [b]Basically, I just really want the game to be much more dynamic and personalized based on how the player interacts with the game world.[/b]

-Combat as it is right now, is quick, painful, and dirty. Even if you have a clear advantage, you're still likely to come out with some scratches on you. Of course, armor will help - and much more effectively than my previous games at that. Weapon capabilities are also more diversified and streamlined, making them more useful depending on the situation. I've already made changes (a lot) to the combat system to make it more enjoyable and dangerous. For you and the enemies. I've also decided to make custom animations for EVERY WEAPON so it may take longer, but I think it'll make it a lot better. 

-The game is not always meant to be perfectly "fair", but that counts for everyone. What I mean is, if you can do something, your enemy likely can to and vice versa, but sometimes you may find yourself in a serious bind and you'll need to play your cards carefully to get yourself out.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/9183f8dbd6c925d659fee4a7908686336dff2dbf.jpg[/img]

-I'm pretty much building it from the ground up from scratch, creating a lot of custom assets (and a friend is helping me with character design stuff) so it will take time, but it will also be much more original. For music (soundtracks), I have a really awesome selection that fits my vision perfectly. I'm really excited to see it all put together.

-For character creation/design, I can say that there is a TON OF DEPTH. Skills, attributes, traits, flaws (something new that I wanted to do), occupation, etc. Characters are not all-powerful. They have limits and drawbacks. Psychological trauma and defects as well as physical with varying effects. Backgrounds will give key bonuses in various areas of influence that can help or hinder you in situations depending on what you have available. There are also going to be more out of combat skills so the game has more variety.

There is a lot more I want to talk about and show off, but this is already turning into a novel, so I will wrap it up for now.

If you want to discuss the game, give ideas, or just have the link to the hub, you can find a link to the Chaos Chain Steam Community Hub here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1536730

I'll have more information soon.

Thanks for reading!

[url=https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/1a3994ccd145768199bf31edb79d01bdea1cb37d.png][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/551a162736ad2ccd578f3145ff1e02529870d419.png[/img][/url]

-[b]Eric "Corrosion" Plasencia

notes.title: 8/12/21 FREE Content Update 2.1.5 (Environmental Graphical Improvement) #2!
notes.content:
[b]Waste Walkers[/b],

Hey everyone!

It's been 7 years... It's hard to believe it.

Anyways, I decided to do a bit of work on improving the environments in Waste Walkers to make them look a bit more gritty, look more like an apocalyptic wasteland, and to all blend together a bit more.

This update is for the base game AND the expansions. It is exclusively a FREE "thank you" overhaul for all owners and my supporters of Waste Walkers [u]on Steam[/u]. Thank you so much for all of your help over the years. Steam has been the only real place that players have truly showed their support and made this all possible. You're all wasteland legends to me! ːWWFAKː

If you don't own the game on Steam, it's okay. You can still get this update if you ever do buy the game here. If you just got it for free elsewhere, I'm not updating local/individual copies. This is exclusive as a "thank you" for people who actually have helped me directly.

If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a positive review so I can continue to do this. Constructive feedback is always welcome as well!

I hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: 5/6/21 QOL Update 2.1.0 / Chaotic Wastes Expansion Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Waste Walkers[/b],

Hey everyone!

This is a QOL update and also to implement the upcoming Chaotic Wastes Expansion DLC.

[b]Update 2.1.0 Change Log:[/b]

Changes & Additions:
-Reorganized the intro text to be more easily readable
-Expanded the intro background image to fit the entire screen
-Tinted the intro image to better fit the game
-Set a specific music track for the intro scene
-Added some additional help text to character creation
-Added handlers for the incoming Chaotic Wastes Expansion
-Added 11 different World Modifiers for the Chaotic Wastes Expansion

Now let's look at the expansion details.

"[b]Chaotic Wastes Expansion DLC:[/b]

The Chaotic Wastes Expansion for Waste Walkers adds an extra system for replayability and for creating unique playthroughs and challenges. The system will randomly select 3 of 11 possible world modifiers that each have a unique effect on gameplay and the game world. These may be rerolled up to 5 times so you can choose which ones you want to play with. It can either be activated by starting a new game, or by simply accessing your personal stash in your home.

[list]
[*]Chaotic Combat: All hit point damage in battle can be up to 2 points higher.
[*]Prepper: Start at level 2, but enemies may also start 1 level higher.
[*]Sadism: All criticals count for 3x damage instead of the standard 2x damage.
[*]SSDD: No effects good or bad. You got lucky.
[*]Slim Pickings: All enemies have 10% less health, but 5% more accuracy and evasion.
[*]Contamination: All pre-bomb food items give radiation, but are more abundant.
[*]Lonely Road: You cannot have a companion (at least until you gain the leadership trait), but your character gains several buffs.
[*]Mad Mutants: All mutants gain 15 bonus initiative and 5% critical chance, but lose 10% hit points and morale.
[*]Skillful: Gain 10% more experience, but enemies are 10% more likely to target you.
[*]Desolate: It is much more likely to storm and weather changes more rapidly.
[*]Combat Training: You gain 5% accuracy and evasion, but earn 20% less experience.
[/list]

*For those of you who have played our fourth game, Lawless Lands, this is essentially an expansion to add the same type of Campaign Modifier system which Lawless Lands had. This was one of the most praised features in that game, so it has also been added to Waste Walkers.*

[b]PLEASE NOTE: IN ORDER [u]TO ACTIVATE THIS PACK, YOU MUST ACCESS YOUR PERSONAL STASH INSIDE YOUR [i]HOME[/i] OR BEGIN A NEW GAME. YOU ARE NOT REQUIRED TO START A NEW GAME, BUT THIS WILL ACTIVATE AUTOMATICALLY WHENEVER YOU DO - DURING CHARACTER CREATION[/u][/b]!"

The expansion will be available for $2.99 or your local equivalent in a few days!

Enjoy!

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: 3/10/21 Gamepad/Controller Support Update 2.0.5
notes.content:
[b]Waste Walkers[/b],

Hey everyone!

Like my other two games, Lawless Lands and Disgraced, I have added gamepad and controller support for Waste Walkers!

It's been a long time coming, but I finally had time to really investigate this and get it sorted.

It's not perfect, but I've done a lot of testing with my xbox-360/xbox-one controller and it's working.

[b]IN ORDER TO TOGGLE BETWEEN KEYBOARD OR GAMEPAD, THERE IS A FILE IN THE GAME'S INSTALL DIRECTORY CALLED "gamepad.txt"!

TYPING "1" INTO THE FILE WILL ENABLE THE GAMEPAD AND DISABLE THE ADVANCED KEYBOARD SUPPORT.

TYPING "0" INTO THE FILE WILL ENABLE THE ADVANCED KEYBOARD SUPPORT AND DISABLE THE GAMEPAD.

BASED ON ENGINE LIMITATIONS, THIS IS THE ONLY WAY I HAVE FOUND TO DO THIS.

YOU MAY NEED TO RUN THE GAME AS ADMINISTRATOR FOR THIS TO WORK.[/b]

Here is a guide on how to use it: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2420644683

This change applies to the game and the expansions!

Update 2.0.5 Change Log:

Changes & Additions:
-Added "gamepad.txt" File to the Install Directory with a Default Setting of "0" (the gamepad is disabled and the advanced keyboard is enabled / setting to "1" will reverse the effect)
-Added a Default Control Scheme for Gamepads

You should NOT need to start a new game.

If you have any issues or concerns, please let me know.

The update will be available publicly soon.

-Corrosion

notes.title: Quick PSA: Recent Rapid Updates
notes.content:
[b]Corrosive Supporters[/b],

Hey everyone!

I just wanted to drop by real quick and mention this. Some of you may have noticed a few small updates to Waste Walkers, Disgraced, and Lawless Lands, last night. I was adding a quick menu option to the title screen which will let you check out my other games.

Due to the way Steam detects you being in a game or not, the browser which opened the link to my Steam page was being viewed as the game running, so I'm trying to find a work-around. This is a Steam thing and not directly caused by me because the game is spawning a child process and Steam sees that as part of the game itself. As you can imagine, it's quite annoying. All I wanted to do was link my other work.

I'm currently investigating alternative methods in Ruby to combat this. If you have any suggestions, feel free to post here.

What I've tried:
-Thread.new - Steam still thinks the game is running even if the game closes but the browser remains open
-Fiber.new - Steam still thinks the game is running even if the game closes but the browser remains open

Currently Trying:
Separate Batch File - My thinking is that if I have the game just launch a batch file that separately opens the website, independently of the game running, then Steam won't detect it as the game is still running

Thank you for reading.

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Would You Like to See Waste Walkers 2?
notes.content:
[b]Corrosive Supporters[/b],

So, it's been an idea I've had for a little while, it's been several years since the first Waste Walkers came out. Would you like to see Waste Walkers 2?

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/0ab805fd5e951a3dd1f9a5511e4a38606e732378.png[/img]

Link to the first for discussion purposes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/371100/Waste_Walkers/

Now, it's going to depend on a lot of things, but I could start heading in that direction in as little as a couple of months. I need feedback, though, and I want to hear what you have to say. This is really my first time mentioning a sequel to the game (or any game for that matter) so it's just a topic of discussion for now. Nothing is definite.

The original game had the largest following of any of my games and tens of thousands of players. In the first few years, it was wildly popular and exceeded my expectations by a long shot. It was however, my first game. That means it was when I had first started college, barely had any idea about game design or programming, and just had a vision and brought it to life. Now, I have all of the above. Features that never made it into the first game are now second nature to me. I could do it, and I would, but it has to be viable for me because I would love to work for free and on nothing but good intentions, but I obviously cannot do so.

The expansions for the first game were well received and gained me a lot of momentum and great income for a time. I was able to focus on new projects and develop my skills further. The story in Waste Walkers Deliverance was hailed as my best storyline for the game as a whole and in general, I think it was some of my best storytelling and work.

I already have some scattered plans for this, but now is your time to communicate with me and discuss this idea. What did you like or not like about the first game? What fell short? What was great? Would you be interested in a sequel? Tell me!

The only way I'd be able to do this is to start off with a Kickstarter. I'd have to have at least some form of financial support to do this to sustain myself and help keep the lights on while I work on it. If I don't create this, I'll likely be leaving the RPG Maker engine behind for good to go work on later and greater things. Primarily Unreal engine now that I have the skills and knowledge to support it.

Please let me know what you think. I would really value your opinion and your feedback.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/371100/discussions/0/3004425113436201694/

Thank you.

-Eric "Corrosion" Plasencia

notes.title: Corrosive Studios 5 Year Anniversary Sale!
notes.content:
[b]Corrosive Supporters[/b],

Well, today Corrosive Studios turns 5 years old. I can't wrap my mind around that. I think back to the day I got my first game (Waste Walkers) greenlit and at 19 years old, I ran around the house screaming with joy like a little kid. Sometimes it gets tough, but I wouldn't trade it for the world.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6836576/44bb6d7556246492c865b9a1f397e6cedb1e6b0f.png[/img]

It's been a long and amazing journey and I hope that I have many more years ahead. I wouldn't be here without all of the friends and support that I have been lucky enough to have found throughout this time. I honestly can't believe it's been 5 years. Time flies. I cannot express the happiness in my heart today. It's almost unreal.

As for sales, everything is on sale for huge discounts right now which can be found here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/6836576

The sales will last for a good while and Valve assured me all was set up correctly so don't worry if you have a game you want to get but just can't right now. There is about 2 weeks time for that.

I promised some giveaways, and they shall all happen. The first one (Lawless Lands) can be found here: https://pastebin.com/rgMjLwcB

Please do us all a favor and post here as a comment if you take one or if others do not, please post when they are all taken. It saves everybody a few stopped heartbeats. ;-)

Thank you to everyone who has helped me grow and been there to support me in this time. You're truly appreciated and I consider you a close friend, even if we've never spoken. I hope you all continue to enjoy my games and I'll continue to do my best to make them.

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Corrosive Studios Turns 5 Years Old Soon!
notes.content:
[b]Corrosive Supporters[/b]

Hey everyone!

It's hard to believe, but it's true. Soon, Corrosive Studios will turn 5 years old. On September 20th, 5 years ago, my dream came true. With a few solid friends and supporters, a little bit of game making knowledge, some basic programming knowledge, and a lot of ideas, Corrosive Studios was born!

Thanks to all of you who have supported and helped me out, the dream soon became reality and has lasted for 5 whole years so far! I hope this continues and I am able to make many more games for everyone to enjoy.

As a thank you, I'll be doing some giveaways on the 20th, and ALL of my products will be on sale for SUPER cheap.

I'll let you all know when the sales go live and when I am doing the giveaways!

Thank you all again for the support and kindness!

notes.title: LIMITED TIME OFFER - Your Chance to be in Lawless Lands
notes.content:
[b]Lawless Lands[/b],

Hey everyone!

=== [b]Introduction:[/b] ===

This announcement is mainly for fans of the game and people who would like the chance to appear in the game either by getting a custom skin for their own use or by appearing as an NPC. Or Both! Or create a quest of your very own!

Starting tomorrow on the 7th of February, a special limited time offer and promotion is going to be done for the game. [u]This will run until the 7th of March[/u], so it is for one month.

=== [b]Details:[/b] ===

If you'd like to support the game further and appear in game, all you have to do is donate a minimum of $2.50 USD to our donation paypal account!

=== [b]Fine Details:[/b] ===

[b]Militia[/b] Donators who donate $2.50 or more USD will be able to submit a custom skin that [u]they have made[/u] and they will be able to play as it in the game and [u]get a boost of 50 gold lords[/u]!

[b]Guard[/b] Donators who donate $5.00 or more will have [u]a skin made for them[/u] (as they describe) and will be able to play as them in game and [u]get a boost of 100 gold lords[/u]!

[b]Soldier[/b] Donators who donate $10.00 USD or more will be able to [u]create their own NPC to be seen by everyone in thegame[/u]. Tell us who you want them to be, what you want them to say, and anything else you can think of! They also [u]get a boost of 200 gold lords[/u]!

[b]Captain[/b] Donators who donate $20.00 USD or more will be able to [u]write a side quest to appear in the game[/u] and be played by everyone! This can be pretty much anything as long as it fits into the theme of the game - medieval, low fantasy. They also [u]get a boost of 400 gold lords[/u]!

=== [b]How it Works:[/b] ===

Interested players and community members can make their donations here:
https://www.paypal.com/donate/?token=l5PaVf3Ds_APMjxdEENCD-4Nrq4U2ra1OtA0jxi_QVQLgjAfahMpNQcrT02kT3vExB4n5G&country.x=US&locale.x=US

When you make a donation, send an email to: crsvstudiosspprt@gmail.com and let us know that you sent in a donation. We'll confirm with you within 2 business days. Depending on the amount you donated, we'll go from there.

*For people donating to get their skin in game, they'll need to give us a name of 16 characters or less that they can type in for their name when they make their character and that will be used to activate their skin and grant them their bonus gold lords.*

So, to sum it all up in some quick and easy steps:

1-Decide if you want to donate or not

2-Decide on how much you want to donate (please see the ranks above)

3-Donate to https://www.paypal.com/donate/?token=l5PaVf3Ds_APMjxdEENCD-4Nrq4U2ra1OtA0jxi_QVQLgjAfahMpNQcrT02kT3vExB4n5G&country.x=US&locale.x=US

4-Send an email to crsvstudiosspprt@gmail.com and tell us who you are and how much you donated so that we can confirm

5-We'll get back to you within 2 business days and start figuring out how to get your content in the game

6-Your content will be added and you'll be able to access it in the next update

[u]Remember, this offer starts tomorrow on the 7th of February and ends on the 7th of March, one month from tomorrow[/u].

If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to post here or send an email to: crsvstudiosspprt@gmail.com

See you soon!

***PLEASE NOTE: If you are already a donator or VIP, you do not need to donate here in order to benefit from these rewards. Just message me personally.***

-[b]Corrosion[/b] :CStudios:

notes.title: Lawless Lands Early Access Now Available
notes.content:
[b]Corrosive Supporters[/b],

The time has come!

Lawless Lands is now avaiable for purchasing and playing in Early Access on Steam!

Check it out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/880130/Lawless_Lands/

[b]Arise:[/b]
[list]
Plunge into the Lawless Lands of Crossia, a once great kingdom where chaos slowly consumes more and more of the country. The cities have plummeted into poverty and crime, and the surrounding countryside is littered with famine and death. The army is close to collapse from an ever-lasting war and cannot stop the spread of the disorder. Hope is almost nonexistent, restoring order is believed to be futile, and panic lingers everywhere. Take on the role of a champion who rises from the ashes to end the suffering.
[/list]

[b]Muster and Rally:[/b]
[list]
Create the character of your dreams with complete customization including traits, skills, training, abilities, companions, appearance, and an open-ended advancement system that allows you to improve and expand however you wish, without being limited by a class or tier based leveling system. Then, play how you choose with whatever equipment and gear that suits your favored playstyle for your adventures!
[/list]

[b]Stand Firm:[/b]
[list]
Arm and upgrade your character with skills and a huge armament to better allow them to face constant and ever growing challenges. Enemies improve as you and your company do, and so do the other various dangers and threats that stand in your way. Plan accordingly for each and every adventure.
[/list]

[b]Main Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Epic main storyline with hours of diverse gameplay
[*]Sprawling open world on a massive scale
[*]Intricate character development with familial backgrounds, occupations, traits, 36 different skins, a vast number of skills, abilities, spells, and more
[*]Countless side quests and activities that add to the lore of the game world
[*]Randomized loot and encounters
[*]Hundreds of items, gear, and equipment choices
[*]Basic inventory management system
[*]Simple durability and degradation system for weapons and armor
[*]Dozens of different enemies, each with their own behaviors, tactics, and personalities
[*]Extensive and easy-to-use crafting system
[/list]

[b]Other Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Original soundtrack themes
[*]Day/night cycle (1 hour real-time is 1 day in game)
[*]Dynamic and randomized weather patterns
[*]High quality/custom-made graphics and artwork
[*]Support for [u]all Windows computers[/u]
[/list]

[b][u]Please only purchase the game at this time if you're willing to deal with issues and unfinished content! The game will be updated constantly so it may be best to wait if you're unsure.[/u][/b]

I hope everyone who decides to try it out really enjoys it! I've been working really hard the past several months on it! Please do let me know of any bugs or problems on the forums!

-[b]Corrosion[/b] :CStudios:

notes.title: What's Going On
notes.content:
[b]Corrosive Supporters[/b],

Hey everyone!

Just wanted to post a quick announcement to talk about what I've been up to.

Affliction, my current project is just about finished. It should only be another week or two, if all goes well.

I've been brainstorming hundreds of ideas for my next project which I will be starting almost immediately after Affliction is done because I'm so excited to work on it. I decided that I wanted to do a low-fantasy, medieval, open world role playing game with a massive scale. From my past role playing games, I'll take the knowledge that I've acquired, take the favorite features from them, and bring them back in a bigger, and better way. Of course, I'll be adding a lot of new stuff to the game too. I plan to make custom graphics for everything, get good sounds and music, and of course, create an enjoyable experience. It will be, by far, my largest project yet. I want to really go all-out with this. It will be flavored by the high medieval period of Western Europe and be sprinkled with low-fantasy and low-magic.

My current  inspirations are:
The Neverwinter Nights series
The Baldur's Gate series
Dungeons & Dragons
The Witcher series
The Stronghold series
The Medieval Total War series
The Mount & Blade Series
Chivalry: Medieval Warfare
Grim Dawn
The Black Death movie
The Ironclad movie series
The Lord of the Rings movie series
The Conan movie series
And MANY more...

I don't want to give too terribly many details right now, but hopefully some people will be excited about this next direction that I want to take.

If you'd like to donate and help me with this next project, the link can be found below. I truly do appreciate any and all donations as they help me pay for various pieces and parts needed for my game projects.

Paypal Donations Link: https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_donations&business=eplasencia.rvn%40gmail.com&lc=US&item_name=Corrosive%20Studios%20LLC&currency_code=USD&bn=PP-DonationsBF%3abtn_donateCC_LG.gif%3aNonHosted

notes.title: Renegade Tabletop Tools System - Now Available
notes.content:
[b]Corrosive Supporters[/b],

RTTS is now availble to purchase and use! It is currently on a launch discount for 10% off! Grab it while it lasts!

The Renegade Tabletop Tools System consists of two powerful, but very easy to use tools to aid in tabletop or net-based role-playing sessions.

You can get it here:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/760970/Renegade_Tabletop_Tools_System/

Renegade Dice Roller System:
-The Renegade Dice Roller System (RDRS) simply and effectively simulates rolling any number of dice with any number of sides, any modifiers, and will break down the mathematic equation results for you and display them for easy understanding. It also keeps a running total of which dice is being rolled and the grand total of all rolls combined. This can be used as a substitute for the chore of rolling real dice and help speed up combat, determining initiative, large scale battles, and much more!

Renegade Entity Dictionary System:
-The Renegade Entity Dictionary System (REDS) allows users to create and edit lists of entities, view lists, save lists as files, load list files, update list files, purge lists, and even retrieve a random entity from a list. This can be used to create lists of different game elements for nearly any gameplay aspect including loot, adventure, time, weather, location, enemies, and so much more! The sky is the limit!

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: 9/8/17 Free Content/Thank You Update 1.9.4
notes.content:
[b]Waste Walkers[/b],

As a thank you to everyone helping out with the Hurricane Relief Effort and after seeing that a lot of people wanted this, I decided to label both the in game map for the main game, and the map image file that comes with the game. This was something a lot of players complained about not having and getting lost easily. That shouldn't be the case anymore. It was originally designed in this way to encourage slow and complete exploration but since the game is meant as a sandbox style rpg, it has been changed. It is just like the DLC expansion Deliverance, which was highly praised for having a labeled map.

The map may be a bit cluttered with text, but it's certainly way more helpful than it previously was.

[b]Update 1.9.4 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes:
-No bug fixes necessary

Changed & Additions:
-In game map for the base game has been labeled
-Out of game map image file has been labeled

Again, thank you all so very much for your help in raising money to help with Hurricane Relief! You guys rock!

The update will be out shortly.

notes.title: Waste Walkers - Hurricane Harvey Relief Effort
notes.content:
[b]Waste Walkers[/b],

As many of you are well aware, Hurricane Harvey devastated many of the southern coastal states. As a Texas resident myself, I saw some of it first hand.

For the month of September, I plan to donate a large percentage of all profits from Waste Walkers to the relief effort. If you'd like to help out, please continue to read.

I'm asking anyone and everyone who'd like to help support the victims of the storm, to please purchase Waste Walkers or any of it's DLCs to help those in need. Every little bit helps no matter how little you may spend. 

I've taken it upon myself with my family to personally send supplies including food, clothing, pet food, baby supplies, medical supplies, clean water, and other various items to help out the survivors living in chaos.

A lot of people either have ignored the issue or have not heard of how bad it is for not only Houston, but the surrounding towns and neighboring cities. Even other states.

Don't do this for me or my business, think of the people who could use the money to help them get their lives back on track. Think of how you'd feel in their situation. You'd probably need some help and feel very appreciative of any donations or help received.

Please, if you're able, help me do what's right.

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Waste Walkers - Hurricane Harvey Relief Effort
notes.content:
[b]Waste Walkers[/b],

As many of you are well aware, Hurricane Harvey devastated many of the southern coastal states. As a Texas resident myself, I saw some of it first hand.

For the month of September, I plan to donate a large percentage of all profits from Waste Walkers to the relief effort. If you'd like to help out, please continue to read.

I'm asking anyone and everyone who'd like to help support the victims of the storm, to please purchase Waste Walkers or any of it's DLCs to help those in need. Every little bit helps no matter how little you may spend. 

I've taken it upon myself with my family to personally send supplies including food, clothing, pet food, baby supplies, medical supplies, clean water, and other various items to help out the survivors living in chaos.

A lot of people either have ignored the issue or have not heard of how bad it is for not only Houston, but the surrounding towns and neighboring cities. Even other states.

Don't do this for me or my business, think of the people who could use the money to help them get their lives back on track. Think of how you'd feel in their situation. You'd probably need some help and feel very appreciative of any donations or help received.

Please, if you're able, help me do what's right.

-[b]Corrosion[/b] :CStudios:

notes.title: Details of Our Next Project - Affliction
notes.content:
[h1][b]Affliction[/b][/h1]

[i]Based in the fictitious Eastern European country of Ghulovka, amidst a terrible political crisis, [b]Affliction[/b] allows players to take on the role of a patient who awakes in a bizarre research facility. With no memory of their reason for being there, players are forced to fight for their survival while frantically seeking answers to discover the truth behind their identity and unveil the mystery surrounding the horrific purpose of the facility.[/i]

[b]Affliction[/b] is a dark action/adventure game designed to engage players with its surreal lore that features a thrilling storyline where players must fight, scavenge, and use anything at their disposal to its full potential if they hope to escape and live to tell the tale. Players will experience the terrifying possibilities of chemical and biological warfare from a first person perspective. The game features many different locations to explore including a disturbing research facility, a dark wilderness, a desolate city, and more. Exploration can be rewarding, but it can also be very unforgiving. Players are advised to use extreme caution.

[b]Gameplay Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Gripping Storyline With a Blend of Action, Adventure, Horror, Thriller, and Sci Fi Elements
[*]Open World Exploration
[*]Diverse & Unique Characters
[*]Multiple Weapons to Choose From
[*]Lore Items to Further the Story
[*]Numerous Locations to Explore
[*]Several Different Enemies
[*]Environmental Interaction
[*]Basic Resource Management System
[/list]

[b]Visual & Audio Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Frightening Atmosphere
[*]Haunting Soundtrack
[*]Sprawling Handmade Environments
[*]Detailed Graphics
[/list]

[b]System Requirements:[/b]
[list]
MINIMUM:
OS: Microsoft Windows (32-bit/64-bit) 
Processor: Intel Dual-Core 2GHz or AMD Dual-Core 2GHz
Memory: 4 GB RAM 
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 400 series or AMD Radeon HD 6000 series, 1GB Video Card (Minimum Shader Model 2.0) 
DirectX: Version 9.0c 
Storage: 5 GB available space 
Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
Additional Notes: May run on systems with lower specs, but with poor performance
[/list]

Here isa short youtube teaser:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xJ9ow0LfBJc

[b]Other Games By Corrosive Studios:[/b]
[list]
[*]Waste Walkers - http://store.steampowered.com/app/371100/
[*]Disgraced - http://store.steampowered.com/app/485360/
[/list]

[b]The Greenlight page will be live within the next few weeks![/b]

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Community Thanks & Some Interesting Data
notes.content:
Hello!

We wanted to give you all some interesting statistics and data that we've gathered.

Up until now, we've sold over 50,000 copies of our games. Not all sales have been made on Steam, but roughly 70% of that number has.

We've helped raise just under $20,000 for various charities around the world. Mainly ones that are for medical research. We didn't do this alone, but we certainly helped.

We genuinely didn't want to take part in bundles in the beginning, but we realized that it was a great way to introduce our products to the public. We've participated in 8 bundles to date and have to admit that we probably wouldn't be where we are if we hadn't joined them.

We started off with a community/following of around 50 people. We've since accumulated over 5000. That's 100x more...

We started off making our first project, Waste Walkers, as a hobby. Thinking we'd only make a few thousand dollars. We've begun to close in on the hundred thousand dollar mark. Not only did our first project do extremely well, so did our second one, Disgraced.

We started off as a single-man team with little experience in game development. We grew and now have a team of around 10 people who all have various jobs whether they be for testing, marketing, artwork, sound design, or anything else.

Despite various sources of negativity, Corrosive Studios has only grown and prospered since its initial founding. Steam certainly helped us accomplish what we've done so far. The community is the biggest contributor to our success however, and we must say that the community's input in the development of our first few games truly made them what they are today.

Just wanted to share some of those things with you guys! Thank you so much for all of your help and support. We wouldn't be where we are today without each and every one of you!

Our new project will be available for everyone to see and vote for on Greenlight in the next few weeks. We hope you will join us again to make another great game!

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Corrosive Studios - Our Next Project
notes.content:
Hello!

This is a quick announcement to let everyone know that we've really started working on our next project. We'll be releasing more details in the very near future but for now we've got a few basic hints for you. The game will be a first person style game and will be a mix of adventure/action/horror/thriller/sci fi. It will be on a 3D engine and will be a huge improvement over our previous titles.

As some of you may have heard, Steam is removing their Greenlight feature and replacing it with something called Steam Direct. Basically, we won't need votes to get our games on Steam anymore. We'll have to pay a recoupable entry fee that we earn back as our games make profit. This feature isn't being changed for the next few months.

In the meantime, we'd love to get the game greenlit before the changes take place so we can see what you (the community) would like to see in the game. We'd like to ask all of our followers and community members to join us once again in creating an awesome game! We hope to see you all there.

We will post a link to the Greenlight page when it is ready!

We hope you're all looking forward to it as much as we are!

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Waste Walkers Role Playing Game DLC Update
notes.content:
[b]Waste Walkers[/b],

This is an announcement to say that a new file has been added to this DLC called "Waste Walkers Weaponry Original" which contains hundreds of weapons and each comes with their own unique stats, modifications list, and more. This is the legitimate original file from years ago when the game was initially written. We thought it was lost, but it was recovered just moments ago from an old hard drive which was going to be wiped... Good save, eh? ːWWFAKː

This list of weapons will seem to go on and on but it's definitely worth it because they're all 100% good to go. ːWWPKː

Some of you may have noticed in the other versions of the weaponry files that there were only a few shotguns and many of the weapons were not ported between rule sets but this will correct that issue. ːWWCrowbarː

This is Waste Walkers. ːWWGasmaskː

We hope you all enjoy this, we're very excited about it. ːWWBackpackː

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Second Project By Corrosive Studios
notes.content:
[h1]Disgraced[/h1]

http://i.imgur.com/FLZMBDK.png

[i]Based in Feudal Japan, Disgraced allows you to assume the role of a soldier who was conscripted into the newly proclaimed Shogunate's army. Serving a corrupt government, you're forced to do unspeakable things and commit terrible atrocities. Torn between duty and justice, you must choose your own path, and forge your own destiny.[/i]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fictional Story Based On Real Events
[*]Character Creation, & Development
[*]Open Class Leveling System
[*]Dynamic Story & Decision System
[*]Open World Exploration
[*]Consuming Atmosphere
[*]Diverse & Unique Characters
[*]Advanced Companion System
[*]Faction System
[*]Faction Supply & Level System
[*]Base Upgrade & Management System
[*]Hundreds of Choices for Equipment
[*]Equipment Durability & Degradation System
[*]Face Constant & Evolving Challenges
[*]Randomized Loot System
[*]Dozens of Maps, Areas, & Lands to Explore
[*]Authentic Soundtrack
[*]Dozens of Different Enemies
[*]Advanced Combat System
[*]Dozens of Side Quests
[*]Multi-Layered Skill System
[*]Day/Night Cycle
[*]Randomized Weather Patterns
[*]Upgraded Graphics
[*]Beautifully Crafted Environments
[*]Replayability
[*]Full Mouse & Keyboard Support
[*]Support For All Windows Computers
[/list]

More information will be released at a later time.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=659647363

notes.content:

notes.title: 3/9/16 Update 1.8.8 [Role Playing Update]
notes.content:
[i]Waste Walkers,[/i]

Crisis Averted. The achievement problems we had earlier have been fixed and the game has been updated to compensate everyone for the issues. This issue should NOT happen again. I have made sure everything is solid.

Additions & Changes:
-Added antibiotics to the game
-Added more items to the loot tables
-Updated shop listings
-Added slam attack for ghouls
-Changed icons for all ammunition types to make them more easily recognizable

As an even bigger apology compensation, the Deliverance DLC will be 25% off for the launch week instead of 10% off.

I want to sincerely apologize to everyone for the inconvenience.

notes.title: [Fixed] Urgent Message To Waste Walkers Players
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This is a message to inform everyone about an issue that has recently come up concerning the Steam achievement integration for Waste Walkers. 

Issue: Last week, the Steam beta branch had an update that would cause WW to crash each time a call was made to unlock an achivement. This week, Steam put that update to the standard branch. This causes WW to be fairly unplayable through Steam right now.

Work-around: All hope is NOT lost, you can still play WW but you have to run it from the game install directory which you can find by right clicking on WW in your library, select properties, local files tab, browse local files. In there, you'll see a game.exe. Run that if you want to play WW. You will NOT be able to unlock achievements at this time.

Solution: I am working closely with Steam staff right now to figure out a solution to the problem. I'll keep everyone updated.

Please reply in this thread if you have any questions or concerns.

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Waste Walkers Deliverance Status Update
notes.content:
[i]Waste Walkers[/i],

This is just a quick status update to let everyone know how development of the Deliverance expansion for Waste Walkers is going. It's way ahead of schedule and all is going very well at the moment. Two of the three acts are already completely finished, new enemies and gear work well, the new town is almost completed, and the third act is coming along well. There are already around 20 side quests, over 10 tasks for the main quest (not including conversational tasks), and plenty of other things to do. New skills and some other minor adjustments are being added too. New crafting schematics have also been introduced along with many new items that can be crafted. This will feature more immersion than the original game with footstep sound effects that change as the terrain does, more environment sound effects, a deeper story, and much more. This is looking very promising at the moment. 

It may even be released a little ahead of schedule. You can find more information here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/439900/

I hope everyone is as excited as I am!

[i]As always, be safe Waste Walkers.[/i]

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

[i]Waste Walkers[/i]

Hello everyone, this is just a quick heads up that the Awareness DLC for Waste Walkers is live and on sale now!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/443750/

[b]Awareness DLC:[/b]

[I]Enter the world of Waste Walkers through a different perspective. With the Awareness DLC, you'll be stationed in a test lab and given all the supplies, weapons, and equipment you could ever dream of having. You'll have access to everything from Waste Walkers and all in one place. All at your disposal.[/I]

[list]
[*]Testing Facility - Test And Tinker With Anything And Everything In The Game
[*]Unlimited Access - Learn Everything There Is To Know About Your Enemies, Gear, And Supplies
[*]Simulations - Practice Against Any Enemy Whenever You Want With No Real Danger To Yourself
[*]Experiment - Get To Test And Try Out All Kinds Of Character Builds To See What Best Suits You
[*]New Features- Check Out Dozens Of New Items, Equipment, Weapons, Skills, And Even Some New Enemies
[/list]

Enjoy!

NOTE: The Deliverance DLC is going to be much bigger than this, this is just something that was highly requested for the meantime. The Deliverance DLC is planned to come out in April 2016.

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: 2/7/16 Update 1.8.3
notes.content:
[i]Waste Walkers[i],

This is a quick update to fix a small issue and also to overhaul the radiation system. Radiation was never implemented as well as I had hoped so now, it will be more threatening.

[b]Update 1.8.3 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed kevlar helmet price (From 32 to 30)

Changes/Additions:
-Changed amount of radiation received from radiation state (Max is 5/second now)
-Changed amount of radiation received from radiated tiles (Max is 25/second now)

The Deliverance DLC is still coming along nicely and progress is steadily being made. I'll have more information about that later. 

[i]As always, be safe Waste Walkers.[/i]

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Waste Walkers - Early Deliverance Expansion DLC Details
notes.content:
[b]Waste Walkers[/b]

[h1]Deliverance[/h1]

This DLC is the result of the numerous community requests to continue to expand on the world of Waste Walkers. This DLC is an expansion for the base game but it is a game of its very own. The Deliverance DLC features a completely new map, new enemies, new equipment, new quests, new characters, a deeper main plot, further background information about how the world came to be the way it is in Waste Walkers, and many more new and highly requested features.

The DLC is planned to be released [u]within[/u] two months from now. The exact date is to be determined.

Here are some previews:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/wjEZrBg.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vehFgfM.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/uBaWlR9.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/QNVSX1c.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/2MPmfOY.png[/img]

NOTE: The framerate is not accurate in the pictures - it drops whenever I take a screen capture.

I hope everyone is looking forward to it as much as I am!

[i]As always, be safe Waste Walkers.[/i]

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

-Fixed thirst at 0 not resulting in game over
-Fixed barricades outside of Free Haven being passable

-Updated the controls scene to include the new button
-Added a picture of the map to the store page

[I]As always, be safe Waste Walkers[/I].

The holiday times are upon us. To celebrate, Waste Walkers will be on sale for the entire holiday sale that starts on Dec 22. As a bonus, members in the Official Waste Walkers Steam Group (Join by clicking "Follow" on the steam store page) will have a chance to get a free key for the game on Steam! Just a few days ago, I also released a free content update featuring some more content - totally free for everyone who owns Waste Walkers! All you have to do to enter the drawing is comment in this announcement, and be part of the community group! If you already own the game, feel free to give the key to a friend as a gift for the holiday. Tell your friends about this to increase the amount of people who can join! Hope to see some new faces (names) and some returning friends!

[i]As always, be safe Waste Walkers[I].

notes.title: Waste Walkers Holiday Sale And A Quick Message To Followers
notes.content:
[i]Waste Walkers[/i],

Hello everyone and happy holidays! To celebrate this year, Waste Walkers will be 33% off for the entire Steam Holiday Sales Event! I hope everyone is enjoying the game and I hope everyone has a great holiday season! The sale will begin soon!

A note to followers: I will be starting my next project very shortly and I will be putting a page up for it on Steam Greenlight. I will release an announcement here when it is presentable. This will be the second game for Corrosive Studios and myself. [i]As always, be safe Waste Walkers[/i].

notes.title: 11/25/15 Update 1.7.6
notes.content:
[i]Waste Walkers[/i],

It's nearly completed! Waste Walkers is almost finished with it's development phase! This is by far the largest update yet and this is one of the last beta updates! This update also has come with achievements! That's right, Waste Walkers now has achievements! The achievements will add an additional form of entertainment for players to enjoy while playing. I hope everyone enjoys the update, I have been working around the clock the last few weeks to bring a huge content addition!

[b]Update 1.7.6 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed dozens of typos
-Fixed clipping and pathing bugs
-Fixed quest log bugs not updating properly
-Fixed a bug where no loot was respawning in boxes of trash
-Fixed sound bugs
-Fixed radiation bug where radiation wouldn't add properly
-Fixed some optimization and runtime issues
-Fixed the HUD being too "in the way"
-Reworded some of the tutorial

Changes & Additions:
-Greatly increased EXP rewards for all quests (they were very small before)
-Increased some tab rewards for quests (most were very small and not really worth the time and effort)
-Completely redesigned the HUD
-Added achievement support
-Added dozens of achievements
-Achievements are live
-Increased level cap from 25 to 30
-Almost completely finished the entire map (95%)
-Updated the ingame map
-Increased radius of the fog of war by about 20%
-Added grisly rat mutant
-Added rat tail misc item
-Added rat meat item
-Added stinger mutant
-Added stinger mutant trophy
-Added background to the intro
-Added "Slipping Away" main story quest
-Added "Scorpio" side quest
-Added "Exterminator" side quest
-Added "Vengeance" side quest
-Expanded the ashen underground map (doubled the size it previously was)
-Added chemical disposal facility area
-Added cdf drain 1 area
-Added cdf drain 2 area
-Added scrap yard warehouse area
-Added radio station area
-Added cheap cinema area
-Added second hand store area
-Added ranger station area
-Added pizza parlor area
-Added meat packing plant area
-Added news office area
-Added vacant building area
-Added park area
-Added another small swampland
-Added 2 collapsed buildings to the city map
-Added much more nature to the city map (puddles, ponds, vegetation, etc)
-Added pipe rifle weapon
-Balanced all enemies (again)
-Balanced stats for enemies as they level up
-Balanced almost all armor equipment
-Balanced a few weapons
-Modified some areas in the game
-Added crafting schematics for the pipe rifle
-Added crafting schematics for head bands
-Added wedding ring accessory (your character's wedding ring) (morale bonuses)
-Added more dialogue to npcs
-Expanded upon the safe hold colony
-Added hardened skill
-Added poisonproof skill
-Removed the stat from camelbaks that gives hydration (was too overpowered)
-Redesigned how the game handles random encounters (no longer based on steps)
-Added hundreds more loot spawns
-Added numerous more stashes around the city map
-Added dozens more enemy spawns
-Added more barricades and clutter to the city map
-Added radiation around barrels with chemicals
-Added more choices to some of the dialogues
-Added another bandit stronghold
-Added more atmosphere sound effects
-Balanced prices of some skills
-Balanced effects of some skills
-Remade some animations
-Increased sound effect volume by 5%
-Lowered music sound effect volume by 5%
-Modified some crafting schematic requirements
-Updated the city map in the game folder
-Balanced loot spawns
-Balanced critical damage
-Changed some colors for effects and battle messages
-Added new special events
-Cleaned up the game files to remove clutter
-Removed some music files that didn't fit in with the game theme
-Increased the brightness of the game by 10%

The last major update will be out soon. The colony system, the final pieces to the main story line, and much more will come in the final update. I hope everyone enjoys the new content until then. Happy Thanksgiving!

Resource Toolkit Purchasers:
All new content will be added with the final release.

NOTE: [u]A NEW GAME IS NECESSARY TO PLAY THE UPDATE SMOOTHLY. YOU'LL EXPERIENCE BUGS, CRASHES, AND ERRORS IF YOU DO NOT START A NEW GAME. SORRY FOR THE INCONVENIENCE.[/u]

[i]As always, be safe Waste Walkers[/i].

notes.title: Status Update - 1.7.4
notes.content:
[b]Waste Walkers[/b],

[img]http://i.imgur.com/cyhnv0q.png[/img]

As you all should know, Waste Walkers is nearing the end of it's development phase. The last update that was released was the latest stable build and the game will stay in this build for some time. This will allow players to play the game and enjoy it without needing to update and reset their progress. This also gives me time to work on finalizing the game. There isn't much mapping left to do but there are still some things that I still plan to add. The player managed colony system, the faction system, more quests, more enemies, more items, more equipment, finalizing the main story line, and finishing the city map once and for all are on my list of things to do. That being said, you'll find a list below of things I have been working on recently.

-Added an underground collapsed & flooded metro (This will add a "dungeon crawling" experience) (Thanks to Resi for his help)
-Man holes to allow entry to the metro
-New equipment options
-New items
-Better sound effects for the environment
-Bug fixes
-Optimization
-More dialogue options
-Overall balance
-Much more

This is an overly simplified list but it will give you some insight on what I have been doing these last few days. The next update won't be out for awhile but rest assured, progress is being made and the next update will be worth the wait. If anyone would like to continue to show their support in the mean time, feel free to grab one of the DLCs that might interest you.

[i]As always, be safe Waste Walkers[/i].

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: 10/19/15 Update 1.7.3
notes.content:
[u]This is the last update for awhile.[/u] This should give players the time to play and enjoy the game without needing to restart a new game and it should be (almost) completely bug free now. The game itself is around 80-85% completed but there is still quite a bit to add. I'll be focusing on getting the last features and content added before updating again. This may change if there are bugs and crashes but this should be the last update for awhile. I hope you enjoy!

Bug Fixes:

-Fixed Rat never finishing his informational line for the main quest
-Fixed some issues with item effects
-Fixed a bug with Dusty's dialogue not updating properly

Changes & Additions:
-Added a barkeep to New Veil (Mathias)
-Added a bar area to New Veil
-Slightly modified New Veil
-Added "Mathias' Special Stew"
-Added a task for Mathias
-Added some foliage and debris around the Eco-Center
-Added three (3) more ways to find information about your family in New Veil (there is now a total of five (5) possible ways - this is to increase the role playing aspect of the game)
-Removed the maps from the game that were only misc items

notes.title: 9/22/15 Update 1.6.6
notes.content:
Before the change notes, here is a quick status update: the main plot story line is being worked on right now so that the game isn't just a role playing sandbox anymore. The first few stages of the main story line will be added soon. If anyone has any ideas for it, please leave them in the comments below. The colony system has some serious work left until it is fully functional but we now know how it will function. The faction system is still a work in progress but isn't going to be as huge as originally planned. There will be some factions that you can choose to help that will have their own quest lines and benefits. We hope everyone is still enjoying the game as it is now. The change log for update 1.6.6 is below.

[b]Update 1.6.6 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed party members that were not currently being used adding their equipment weight to the carried weight (Basically, players had to carry extra gear for nothing)
-Fixed pathing bugs in the old factory
-Fixed a pathing bug with a satellite dish
-Fixed an item typo

-Additions & Changes:
-Added a green face border to active party members (This is so that it is easier to see who is currently active as a follower and who is waiting in the roster)
-Changed ending dialogue for "Deranged Marriage" quest
-Changed some terrain on the city map
-Added dialogue to another npc
-Added more debris to the city map
-Added a few more enemy spawns to the city map

Resource Toolkit Purchasers:
All new characters have been added to the toolkit as well as the active party member face border script and image.

Digital Deluxe Edition Purchasers:
The new Corrosive Studios LLC logo image has been added to the art and desktop backgrounds folder.

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

With all of the feedback given from the community over the last few days, here are some community suggested improvements! Morale 2.0 is also live! :WWFAK:

[b]Update 1.6.3 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes:
-Cigarettes now weigh nothing
-Pain pills now weigh nothing
-Vitamin tablets now weigh nothing
-Soda no longer buffs dex, it now gives some stamina back
-Removed door to the barn near the spawn next to the map edge

Additions & Changes:
-Increase splash screen intro sound effect volume by 35%
-Lowered survival pack morale bonus
-Added more clutter to the city map
-Soda now gives 5 stamina back
-Changed price of gasoline from 10 to 7
-Changed chainsaw attack from 9 to 10
-Changed the color of the menu arrows to brown instead of solid black
-Attributes are now spelled out in the character section

-Sleeping now restores 10 morale
-Morale for all characters has been changed to 100 instead of 10
-Remade some skills to fit with the new morale system

notes.title: 9/10/15 Update 1.6.0
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Wsy26xd.png[/img]
With our 1 year anniversary for Corrosive Studios ːCStudiosː approaching, we'll be releasing several updates containing more community requested content over the next few days. Waste Walkers will also be on sale from the 15th of September until the 25th of September to celebrate. With this update, a tutorial has been added to give new players a better chance at surviving in the world of Waste Walkers. The tutorial is made up of 10 slides that contain information on some of the core gameplay aspects. Another important highlight is the removal of the black borders. They have been replaced with grass. Some of the map still needs to be finished but now you can get around the map much easier! In the near future, the player managed colony system will be released as well. The basic design for the Eco-Center is complete but we still have to do all the advanced functionalities. It will come, but it will take some time. Please be patient and enjoy the update!

[b]Update 1.6.0 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes: ːWWFAKː
-Fixed pathing errors
-Fixed clipping errors
-Fixed some typos
-Fixed dialogue bugs
-Fixed crafting bugs
-Fixed quest bugs

-Removed some equipment from Free Haven shop listings

Additions & Changes: ːWWCrowbarː
-Added tutorial

notes.title: Status Update - 1.6.0
notes.content:
Hello, fellow Waste Walkers! This is just a quick status update to let everyone know that 1.6.0 will be coming out in a few days. The update will have a lot of new content and quite a bit of polishing. One important feature that has been added is the tutorial. After creating your character, you'll be asked if you want to view the tutorial. It is a total of 10 slides that provide basic but valuable information about the core aspects of the game. The player managed colony floor plans are finished and now the systems and advanced functionality are all that is left. The colony system won't be fully released in 1.6.0, but it will be soon. This is going to take some time, so please be patient. We'll have it out as soon as we possibly can. As many of you know, we try to provide quality and quantity so we're going to try making it as bug-free as possible. That being said, the update will also include multiple bug fixes as well as improvements regarding some of the features in game like the quest system. If anyone has any requests or ideas for things they'd like to see in the colony system, please feel free to open a thread on the forums or reply in the comments for this announcement. Update 1.6.0 will be released within the next couple of days. We hope you're as excited as we are about the new update!

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Reviewing Waste Walkers
notes.content:
When reviewing Waste Walkers, if you have an issue with the game or don't like it, please give examples on what would make it better. Instead of just saying "I hope it gets better", leave suggestions or advice for how we can improve the game. As many of you know, Corrosive Studios has taken all community input into consideration so far, and will continue to do so. In order to improve our games, we need to know what needs changing. We simply can't do that based off of "It's not fun", so please, when writing your review, leave advice on how to make it better if you're writing a negative review.

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Waste Walkers - Colony Survey Final Results
notes.content:
Here are the survey results. ːWWBackpackː

  1.  Would you like to be able to build and manage your own survivor colony in Waste Walkers?

[b]94% - Yes[/b] ːWWPKː

6% - No

  2.  How would you like to be able to build and manage your colony in Waste Walkers?

[b]80% - Find a location that can be used as a general shelter that provides all the basic needs of survival and be able to improve and upgrade it with more people, defenses, and customization options.[/b] ːWWCrowbarː

14% - Find a location that can be used as a general shelter that provides all the basic needs of survival for my group. (Safe house/Hide out)

6% - I don't want to be able to build and manage my own colony.

  3.  In Waste Walkers, what kind of building or area would you like to be able to create your colony in?

[b]36% - Eco-Center[/b] ːWWGasmaskː

12% - Warehouse

14% - Bunker

16% - Farm

16% - Fallout Shelter (Safe house/Hide out)

6% - I don't want to be able to build my own colony.

To be clear, the colony system [u]will[/u] be added to the game. The colony will be built in and around an [u]eco-center[/u] and it [u]will be able to be improved and upgraded[/u]. You'll be able to gain survivor residents by doing quests and finding them out among the wastes. [u]This will take some time to fully implement[/u] but rest assured, it'll be worth the wait. While this addition is being worked on, please feel free to post ideas and any suggestions you may have regarding the colony building system. You are [u]always[/u] welcome to post your suggestions on the community hub for anything and everything game related. We look forward to your feedback and continuing to provide a one-of-a-kind gaming experience for everyone. ːWWFAKː

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Waste Walkers - Colony Survey [RE-OPENED]
notes.content:
Due to the voting being very limited by time and the fact that the votes were based on what was "cool" and not focusing on survival aspects, the survey has been re-opened for 2 more days. Please feel free to vote.

To clarify:

Eco-Center: A self sufficient compound that has a clean water and food source as well as a power source. Either being wind turbines or solar panels or any other energy source. This basically mixes the others together and creates a balance.

Warehouse: A well-stocked warehouse that has stored supplies to sustain life but without a renewable supply source, survival is limited.

Bunker: An underground bunker that has supplies that can allow survival. It is made of concrete and reinforced steel that protect it from intruders but without a renewable supply source, survival is limited.

Farm: A farm that has a food source and even a water source but will need to be protected against dirty water contaminating the fields. It is in the open so attacks will be harder to defend against.


Link: https://www.surveymonkey.com/s/D9BKWLZ 

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: 8/21/15 Update 1.5.9
notes.content:
This update brings a couple of huge additions and ideas to the game world. First off, [u]saving has been disabled from the menu[/u]. Don't panic, there is a solution. Players must sleep in a secured area. Secured areas have beds that can be used to sleep in. [u]Players will be brought to the save screen when a bed is slept in[/u]. Players can also get sleeping bags that allow them to save anywhere they want. Sleeping is important and it is vital for the survival of your character. Before, the beds were almost completely useless. Now, they are important. This change will make players carefully consider each and every move they make. This also gives players the sense of having a place to call home or a hide out to rest their head and stash their loot. When the player created base building system is added to the game, this will act as a permanent shelter for characters to save. Another important notable change is to the radiation system. The sound and the image that normally are played and shown while taking radiation only play when players are on a radiated tile. Players can still take radiation after they leave the tile but only for a few seconds. This change was made due to the amount of bugs and problems the old system caused. The last huge change note is the police station area. The police station has finally been added and it is by far the largest area yet. It has a jail in the basement level, the ground floor has offices and briefing rooms, and the second floor has the chief's office and the armory. Players now have the chance to explore and raid a full police station.

[b]Update 1.5.9 Change Log:[/b]

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed multiple dialogue bugs
-Fixed pathing bugs
-Fixed a clipping error on a wall
-Fixed a few quest bugs
-Fixed numerous skill bugs
-Fixed radiation symbol getting stuck on screen
-Fixed shop listings
-Fixed radiation bugs
-Fixed characters being able to purchase an AI-Only skill
-Fixed a schematic typo
-Fixed game not starting in fullscreen mode

Additions & Changes:
-Added additional spacing to the intro text so players have more time to read
-Expanded room for the survival window in the menu
-Added police department area
-Added police department jail area
-Added police department second floor area
-Added swimming pool area
-Added pool entry area
-Added men's lockers area
-Added women's lockers area
-Added "Hell in a Cell" quest
-Added cricket bat weapon
-Added paper cutter blade weapon
-Added shiv weapon
-Added pump action 12 gauge shotgun weapon
-Added rapid pump skill
-Added sks rifle weapon
-Added double tap rifle skill
-Added schematics for shiv (shank)
-Added new loot table (police grade gear)
-Updated shops with new gear
-Updated loot table (military grade gear)
-Changed how beds work (sleep in order to save)
-Removed save option from menu
-Changed some item effects
-Changed the way the game handles radiation
-Changed starting weapon choices
-Schematics now are colored for what type of gear they create (armor = orange, black = weapons, brown = items)
-Modified starting kit and schematics
-Changed the in game art for multiple weapons to look like what they are supposed to represent (placeholders removed)

The next update won't be for awhile since it is a new build (1.6.0) but it will be worth it. The base building system will be implemented and the factions will begin to take form somewhere in the next build and other features will continue to be expanded upon.

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: 8/14/15 Update 1.5.8
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/E94JqqR.png[/img]

This update brings some features into their finalized forms. The intro to the game is finished and the beginning is completely done. This update should also increase the overall difficulty of the game. The loot tables have been significantly modified to lower the chance to find supplies. All supplies should be treated as a gift. Even useless junk. It can be traded for better supplies and equipment. Enemies are a huge threat and you should never be a hero... even if you're totally stocked on high quality gear. All it takes is one mistake and you could wind up as a meal for a mutant or a prize for a raider. Many features are going to be finished up in the very near future and the game will begin to take it's final form. All that's left is mainly mapping, quests, equipment and some last additions.
