-Fixed some bugs related to enemy stats
-Fixed some bugs with dialogues
-Fixed duplicate character companion bug
-Fixed some music tracks not playing properly
-Fixed issue with taking anti-rad drugs and sounds stuttering

-Fixed some enemy drop rates not working as expected
-Removed another song that didn't fit in with the game theme

-Balanced player starting equipment
-Added one-time loot spawns to the player spawn location
-Added crafting schematics for another half dozen items (molotov cocktail included)
-Changed the bandit blaster to throw nail bombs instead of frag grenades (lowered threat)
-Changed the interior of the old house area
-Added florist area
-Added apartment 204 area
-Added forest area surrounding old house
-Added tool shed area
-Added Watcher mutant
-Added Watcher trophy
-Complete loot table overhaul
-Loot balance
-Added bottle of alcohol
-Added "Contact" quest
-Added "Tip Off" quest
-Finished Corrosion's quest line
-Added special reward for all players who complete Corrosion's quest line (3 quests total)
-Changed sound effect for crafting items to the sound of duct tape being ripped
-Balanced enemy stats (overpowered them too much in the last update)
-Updated shops with new items
-Updated Tinkerer schematics list with all new additions
-Added some more lore to dialogues

NOTE: Some save files may be corrupt due to the update. It depends on actions completed in the save and the location of where the save was made.

notes.title: To Everyone Asking For Free Keys To Waste Walkers
notes.content:
Stop asking for free keys. It wouldn't be for sale if it were just being given away. It's cheap and has lots of content. You get your moneys worth. This includes people asking for keys for youtube reviews for viewers and especially subscribers. I can understand wanting to make reviews and let's plays and that will help people see what the game is and it will even help me advertise the game, I will probably be more understanding to that, but asking for keys for subscribers seems like a little too much. I am NOT giving keys away to benefit your channel so you can give it to people so that they subscribe you. This benefits only you. That is outrageous and ridiculous. I worked hard on this game to be pestered through my support email asking for free keys. The support email is my personal email so I can quickly help whoever is having issues. That email is for [u]help and support[/u]. Not for asking for free keys.

Thank you.

-Corrosion ːCStudiosː

notes.content:

notes.title: 7/21/15 Update 1.5.3
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZtKSMv4.png[/img]

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed numerous item spelling/usage/effect bugs
-Fixed pathing problems
-Fixed radiation system bugs
-Fixed Malnutrition quest bug
-Fixed some conversation bugs
-Fixed some combat bugs (states, effects)
-Fixed enemy bugs with resistances and stats
-Fixed bug with Fiend's quest
-Fixed bug where Fiend's name wouldn't appear

Additions & Changes:
-Radiation is now fully implemented
-Reconstructed radiation system
-Environmental radiation is now a constant threat
-Seeker companion
-Compelled quest
-Compeller mutant
-Added compeller trophy
-Added compelled state (makes characters attack teammates)
-HUD survival system addition (see your hunger, thirst, and radiation from the hud) (Thanks to Kurashi and Resi for the help)
-Radition is no longer tracked by rads, millisieverts (msv) is the new unit of measurement
-Radiation max changed from 1000 to 5000
-Changed numerous item effects
-Added multiple radiation pockets around maps
-Added flood puddles around maps (swamplands)
-Added water puddles containing high radiation amounts
-Balanced all enemy drop tables
-Rebalanced all loot tables
-Rebalanced some enemy stats
-Changed prices of some items
-Reduced prices of radiated nourishment items (1/2)
-Changed some sound effects
-Added dog tail
-Added dog chops
-Added dog hide
-Added Radiotherapy Testing Labs Area
-Began working on the "Hunting" part of the game - hunting is actually worthwhile now
-Expanded city map
-Added more rubble and debris around city
-Added Seeker's face to the community avatar list
-Added Gasmask face to the community avatar list

Resource Toolkit Purchasers:
All new character files have been added to the toolkit.

The engine and systems of Waste Walkers are nearly completed. With some tweaking and some fine tuning here and there, Waste Walkers will be entering its beta phase soon and the game won't be totally and rapidly changing anymore. Maps, quests, equipment, and enemies are all that is really left to work on. We hope you've enjoyed the alpha phase of the game and have enjoyed choosing what has been added.

I'd like to say thank you to all of our purchasers, followers, supporters, and fellow Waste Walkers for all of your support and help along the way. The game simply wouldn't be what it is now without the community support that we recieved. We will continue to ask for and encourage community input and feedback to increase the quality of the game. If you have any questions or ideas, feel free to stop by our community hub and open a thread on our forums.

-Corrosion ːCStudiosː

notes.title: First Look At The Factions Of Waste Walkers
notes.content:
In the game world, there will be a handful of factions. They will each be unique but some may have similar ideas and goals with opposing views on how to reach them.

Faction 1: Order
Order is a combination of pre-war politicians and people of power. The government from before the great war. They have the support of the military, or at least what is left of it, and also the remainder of the police force. Any who follow and recognize the previous government's authority is a part of Order. Those who don't, are Order's foes.

Faction 2: Independence
Independence places a strong belief on the ability of the people to live without needing a designated governmental authority. Pre-war, the people who support Independence were considered to be radicals and anarchists. They oppose the beliefs of Order and believe those who were in power prior to the war, caused it, and therefore, caused the apocalypse and should no longer have any authority. They have no recognition of pre-war authorities.

That's just the first look at the factions in Waste Walkers.

-Corrosion ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Introduction To The Faction System
notes.content:
There will be various factions in the game world. Each of these will have their own unique customs and characteristics. Included with the factions will be a reputation and influence system. As your reputation goes up in a Faction, so does your influence. You will have access to gear specific to the Faction, special tasks, companions, and even special skills. 

That being said, no Faction will be forced on the players. This means the player will decide who to assist and who not to assist. There will be neutral factions that will always be friendly and there will be certain factions that will always be hostile.

-Corrosion ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Thanks To All Our Supporters
notes.content:
I'd like to just take a moment to thank all of our supporters and followers. Without your help, Waste Walkers would simply not be what it is today. I've just finished reading all of our reviews and all of our feedback and have made some big decisions and plans for the future of Waste Walkers. 

In the new build (1.5.0), which will be released in a few days, there will be many additions as well as multiple new features introduced. Some of these include an introduction to the faction, reputation and influence system. Also planned are 2 new side quests. There will be an improved anti-lag system added to replace the current system which should improve the overall quality of the game itself. With every update, there are numerous bug fixes that will be included in the latest update as well. One of the most anticipated features coming is the trait system and class system. Though classes will not be like most other games, Waste Walkers will feature a talent system which develops each character differently to add some diversity to the game. The trait system will be an addition to help distinguish characters more in depth. Traits will be obtained through quests, survivor deeds, and during character creation.

Those are just some of the plans of the future of Waste Walkers.

-Corrosion ːCStudiosː

notes.title: For Those Wondering About The Constant Updates
notes.content:
Greetings Waste Walkers. Just to let you all know why there have been so many updates over the past few days, I am going on a vacation with the family and wanted to get some serious progress on the development of Waste Walkers. I have been adding so many new systems, options, and content so that I can take a week without stressing over adding more content. I've done dozens of bug fixes with all the content additions so everything should run smoothly while I am away. My moderators will be in charge of answering questions and helping out in the forums during my leave. When I return, update 1.5.0 will be worked on and that will include a huge amount of content additions. 1.4.8 was the biggest update in the 1.4 series other than the initial 1.4.0 build. I'll be back on the 11th and will resume working on WW on the 12th.

Don't worry, I'll be back with more content soon! In the meantime, enjoy all the new content!

-Corrosion ːCStudiosː

notes.title: A Poll For The Difficulty Of Waste Walkers
notes.content:
Please take this 1 question survey to give us some feedback about the game. Your opinion matters and will impact the game.

https://www.surveymonkey.com/s/5QQ9MDD

Just so everyone knows, Waste Walkers is supposed to be a constant and evolving challenge for every player. We hope no one is finding it too hard or too easy. The goal we have is to make a challenging game that will deliver a thrill for any player.

Thanks!

notes.title: When Will The New Build Be Released?
notes.content:
This is an announcement to give everyone some information. Hotfix builds and patches will only be around 1-5 days in between updates but every 10th build will take longer because it is going to have much more included. We're about to release build 1.4.0 which will have many new features, and content updates. This update will be the biggest update yet and will include a little bit of everything. The ETA on this update being released will be between tonight and tomorrow night. I hope to have it out by tonight but it will most likely be tomorrow in the middle of the day. We have added a journal feature and a quest tracker which will allow players to know exactly what to do for their quests. More quests have been added and quests that were already in game are less buggy and the npcs are not so clunky during conversations about the quests. There will be main plot quests which give extremely low xp in some parts and other parts will have greater rewards. Another thing that has been added is fast travel. You can find guides in all safezones which can bring you to the other safezones for a fee. The further a safezone is, the more it'll cost. Right now, there are two safezones. Free Haven and New Veil. You can fast travel between them for 50 tabs. The supplies available in New Veil have been organized and listed by type and price. Many more equipment choices are now available in New Veil but the person you buy the gear from has changed. There are more traders in New Veil now. Free Haven colony is coming along nicely and we hope everyone is as excited for the new build to release as we are. The game itself has gone through many rapid changes since release and will continue to do so with community input. We value our community and hope more and more community members participate in upcomming events.

You'll be seeing the update shortly.

-Corrosion ːCStudiosː

notes.title: 6/13/15 Update 1.3.8 With Escape 2.0
notes.content:
===Escape 2.0===
Escape 2.0 has been implemented. When you choose the "Flight" option in combat, enemies will be pushed a space away from you on the map so that you have a narrow oppurtunity of retreat. Random encounters (ambushes) will not be pushed back but aborted. Since all encounters on the map are single enemies at once (unless scripted otherwise), you have a chance to escape that specific conflict. If you find yourself surrounded by multiple foes on the map, you'd better get away quickly. You'll be surrounded if you don't. Also, all characters Dexterity (DEX) is now accounted for instead of just the main character and the first enemy of each troop. Successful escapes will be determined by a DEX check for both teams and the player's team will need to be a bit higher in order to succeed.

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed pathing problems
-Fixed quest bugs with nurse at New Veil
-Item art fixes

Additions:
-German Shepard (Nadia) companion now available after a short mini quest

Changes:
-Escape changes
-Old house above beginning basement increased in size and contents
-Explorable house in southern neighborhood is now larger and contains more loot
-Art for some items fixed or changed
-Removed extra assets that weren't game related and unused

ːCStudː

notes.title: Community Contest
notes.content:
Sprite Building Contest ːCStudː

Mission: 
Build a Character sprite and Item sprite for use in game.

Judging/Announcement:
JUNE 15 2015

Rules:
Build and submit only one character design, if you post multiple, your first post will be counted. When building a character, remember this a modern day apocalypse game. Please do not submit any fantasy characters, i.e. wizard, dragon, fairy, vampire, etc. You can however make a mutant, just don’t overdo it, i.e. think of feasible mutations that could occur in real life.
Build and submit (with character) one item design. This can be a food/water item, a weapon/armor, etc. Once again this non fantasy. Think of anything ever made or something that could possibly be made in the next 10 years, i.e. no laser pistols or sharks with laser beams.
Rewards:

1st Place: 
Will have their sprite in game as a “playable” character and “usable” item (everyone can play/use), a special starting item, and receive a free Game Key with all dlc included

2nd Place:
Will have their Sprite in game as an “NPC” (everyone will see), a special starting item and a free copy of one of the dlcs of their choice.

3rd Place:
Will receive a special starting item.

notes.title: COMPLETE Weapon and Armor Overhaul
notes.content:
Armor will now give different amounts of resistance, Weapons will now deal damage of different types: 

Rptr:Rupture: These are slices,chops,claws,scratches,cuts 

Pctr:Puncture: These are stabs,bites,bow damage 

Ipct:Impact: These are punches,kicks,blunt weapons,bashes,falling,crushes,slashes 

Expn:Explosion: This is explosive protection 

Fram:Firearms: Protection against guns,firearms 

Brns:Burns: Protection against fire damage,heat,plasma 

Chem:Chemicals: Protection against chemical spills,chemicals,corrosion 

Rads:Radiation Protection Percentage (Not Yet Available) 

Etrc:Electric Protection,against electricity and lasers,energy 

Tlpy:Telepathy Protection,against controller anomalies,telepathic enemies(bonus to check) (Not Yet Available) 

Cold:Cold Protection percentage against freezing temperatures (Not Yet Available)
